info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Corporate Payroll Services API
info.description: The Corporate Payroll Services API enables organizations to efficiently manage payroll-related banking services for their employees. Through this endpoint, users can access key payroll data and integrate it with their existing financial systems. Typical consumers include HR and finance departments looking to streamline payroll processing and improve data accuracy. This API facilitates operations such as retrieving employee payroll information and managing payment schedules, ensuring compliance and timely disbursement.

get.summary: Retrieve a specific corporate payroll service.
get.description: Fetches detailed information about a corporate payroll service identified by its unique ID. This endpoint is designed for clients needing extensive data about specific payroll services they utilize.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving data related to corporate payroll services, specifically for the operation identified by RES-100045. This request is expected to conform to the specified schema.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the payroll service information.

GetCorporatePayrollServiceByIdRequest.title: Corporate Payroll Services Request Body
GetCorporatePayrollServiceByIdRequest.description: This schema represents the JSON structure expected in the request body for the GET operations related to corporate payroll services. The value should be a string.

GetCorporatePayrollServiceByIdResponse_2.title: Corporate Payroll Services Response
